source: メガトン第 7 居住甲板 (src/world/megaton.js) の改修用。画像が無いあいだは既存の素材に色を付けて代用している。自分で作った 3x3 の画像を assets/textures/sheets/<id>.webp に置くか、texgen.py generate で生成する
style: Small neighbourhood shops of a space-habitat city: diners, grocers and corner stores. Each cell is ONE item seen exactly straight on (or from directly above for floors), filling the cell, flat even light, no shadows, no readable text.

cells.name: mg-noren
cells.prompt: A shop entrance noren curtain: navy cloth split into three panels with a white circular emblem, no letters.

cells.name: mg-menu
cells.prompt: A diner menu wall: a row of wooden menu tags hanging side by side with abstract brush strokes instead of words.

cells.name: mg-shelf-goods
cells.prompt: A store shelf packed with daily goods and snacks in colourful packages, front-on.

cells.name: mg-drinks
cells.prompt: A glass-door drinks refrigerator front: rows of bottles and cans, bright inside light.

cells.name: mg-produce
cells.prompt: A greengrocer display seen from above: crates of tomatoes, oranges, cabbages and hydroponic lettuce.

cells.name: mg-awning
cells.prompt: Shop awning canvas: wide stripes in red and cream, slightly weathered fabric, front-on.

cells.name: mg-register
cells.prompt: The front of a shop counter: wood panels with a small brand-free emblem, a register just visible on top.

cells.name: mg-park-path
cells.prompt: Park footpath from above: compacted light brown earth with fine gravel and a few fallen leaves.

cells.name: mg-play-floor
cells.prompt: Playground safety flooring from above: colourful rubber crumb (red, blue, yellow) with seams.
